parent_evidence.outcome: zero internal successes; three time-expanding frontiers and nine stable closed frontiers

target: Determine whether any already-implemented proof constructor closes a residual before adding a representation or inference primitive.

verifier.internal_success: target-root equality and independent replay_dag acceptance

intervention.selection_rule: Use the single strongest existing configuration for each distinct constructor family; no parameter grid and no new primitive.

live_rivals.H_existing_closure: A disabled or underbudgeted existing constructor already reaches at least one residual.
live_rivals.H_schedule_only: A route works alone but is starved or ordered poorly in the production portfolio.
live_rivals.H_shared_capability_gap: No existing constructor reaches the target, so the residual survives across representations.
live_rivals.H_constructor_language: A route finds a target proof but replay or certificate construction fails.
live_rivals.H_surface_dependence: An apparent result does not survive alpha-renaming and operation duality.
live_rivals.H_soundness: A promoted mechanism proposes TRUE on matched FALSE controls.

outcome_to_action.internal_success: Run official Lean verification, alpha and dual transfer, matched FALSE controls, then full regression before promotion.
outcome_to_action.found_but_replay_failed: Diagnose proof constructor or provenance failure; do not change search.
outcome_to_action.route_exhausted: Record a route-specific closure boundary and compare mechanisms across residual regimes.
outcome_to_action.all_routes_fail: Map cross-route observables and freeze a separator between a shared missing composition and a genuinely absent constructor.
outcome_to_action.unexpected_pattern: Preserve it as a new residual and revise neither diagnosis nor graph ontology until a discriminator is frozen.
